scope: Inference-only diagnosis. Policy eligibility is privileged truthful information on known eligible training claims; any improvement is not deployable or official benchmark improvement. Thirty graphs have eight related variants each; variants are not independent training contexts.
limits: Question wording and supplied eligibility change together; cannot attribute effect to a single wording feature.
Graph topology varies along with path depth, while candidate answers, ordering, edge count and node names are held fixed within each group.
Same-author visible-label checks are not independent external review.
